product.name: Chat
product.description: An AI-powered chat interface for company-wide use, enabling natural language interactions with various AI models.

product.name: Assistants
product.description: Customizable AI assistants tailored to specific use cases, built with custom instructions and integrated knowledge.

product.name: Workflows
product.description: A platform feature to automate repetitive tasks and run AI-driven workflows with human-in-the-loop control.

product.name: API
product.description: A unified API providing access to multiple large language models for building custom AI applications.

product.name: Integrations
product.description: Connectors that link Langdock with existing company tools and data sources to enhance AI functionality.
